name: Shed Tail
effect: The User may deal up to 20% of their Max HP to themself in Wounds. They create a decoy that has the same HP as they chose to sacrifice. When this decoy goes down, they restore the Wounds used to make this decoy but not the HP. The decoy has the same defenses as the User, and all Damaging Moves targeting the User (or targeted ally) used by Foes are automatically redirected to the decoy (including All Foes and Area moves). If used on an ally, both Pokemon gain an Evasion. If it's targeting the user, they gain 2 Evasion. A Pokemon can only gain Evasion from this move once per battle. If the decoy created by this move is targeted by an attack, then the Pokemon protected may use an Evasion token to dodge. The decoy is unaffected by Support moves, Status Ailments, Weather and Stat Changes. A Pokemon may only have one decoy out at a time, and a Pokemon may only be protected by one decoy at a time.
description: The user sheds its tail off, and crafts it into a makeshift dummy to protect an ally.
